purpose: Split every P2E11D FAILED_OR_ENDPOINT_INVALID observation into raw Reference solver/status failure, native residual-gate failure, or exact common-domain endpoint predicate failure, without changing the solver, tolerance, cases or candidate firewall.
matrix_identity: Exactly the P2E11D 30-material x 3 Se x 2 forcing x 5 temporal-level Reference-only replay.
endpoint_predicates: finite pressure head and water content
pressure head strictly inside frozen RossFast E0 head envelope
water content strictly between material theta_r and theta_s

decision_rule.common_endpoint_case: If the central 0.0064 failures are converged Reference solutions rejected only by a frozen common-domain endpoint predicate, classify the extension block as a common-domain boundary rather than a Reference nonlinear failure.
decision_rule.reference_solver_case: If they are raw Reference failures or residual-gate failures, retain the Reference-validity interpretation and do not widen the solver domain.
